name: TrakSpool Firmware
changes: Fixed Wi-Fi networks picked from the OLED menu never connecting — the device required WPA2-PSK and silently refused WPA-only, WPA/WPA2-mixed and WPA3-transition access points even though they appeared in the scan list
Fixed "Enter SSID" manual entry failing to connect when no network scan had been run first — the radio is now started before credentials are stored
